name: Halikor's Hoof

angles.text: Carrying proof of a mighty beast's defeat to Orgrimmar honors Horde traditions of strength and hunting prowess.
As a hunter, bringing down the enormous Halikor shows the skill of the tracker and the thrill of the hunt.

faq.answer: Halikor is a formidable lizard of immense size. Hunters claim its severed hoof as proof that the beast was slain.
The hoof is carried to Orgrimmar as proof of the beast's defeat and the hunter's triumph.
faq.q: Why must the hoof be delivered to Orgrimmar?

faq.answer: You claim Halikor's Hoof from the lizard's body after tracking down and slaying it in combat.

aliases: why does a lizard have hooves
faq.answer: Halikor is a mighty beast of the wilds, and its enormous hoof proves you brought it down. No one has said why it bears a hoof.
faq.q: Why does a lizard have a hoof?

aliases: who accepts halikors hoof in orgrimmar
faq.answer: You carry the hoof to Orgrimmar as proof of your victory. No particular hunter or official is named to receive it.
faq.q: Who in Orgrimmar wants Halikor's Hoof?

faq.answer: The mighty lizard Halikor is slain, and its enormous severed hoof is carried to Orgrimmar. The trophy shows the hunter's prowess and brings the Horde word of the beast's death.
faq.q: What is the story behind the quest Halikor's Hoof?

sections.body: Halikor's vast size is plain in the hoof taken from its remains. Hunters and warriors in the wilds have long claimed a piece of a formidable beast to prove the kill. The hoof leaves no doubt of the lizard's great size and strength.
sections.title: Trophy of a Mighty Beast

sections.body: The heavy hoof is carried to Orgrimmar to announce the beast's defeat to the Horde. Strength and survival against the land's harsh predators matter in this warrior society. Presenting the trophy honors the hunter and assures the capital that a dangerous creature has been slain.
sections.title: Proof for the Capital

summary: In the wilds, Halikor's Hoof is carried to Orgrimmar as proof of a hunter's triumph. The enormous severed hoof honors the hunter's victory over the formidable lizard.
